name: nyloagents
description: Workspace root for the Nylo agent toolchain. Publishes nothing itself.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nylorun/harness && npm run build --workspace @nylorun/create-agent && npm run build --workspace @nylorun/studio
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @nylorun/harness && npm run check --workspace @nylorun/create-agent && npm run check --workspace @nylorun/studio
